cards.q: Which of the following states of matter possesses neither a definite volume nor a definite shape?
cards.why:
**Step 1: Understand physical properties of states of matter**
Solids have both definite shape and volume. Liquids have definite volume but indefinite shape. Gases have neither definite volume nor definite shape as their intermolecular bonds are extremely weak, permitting free molecular expansion.

**Step 2: Compare with options**
Therefore, the correct physical state matching the description is **Gas**.

**Step 2: Conclusion**

cards.title: 1.3.1 Applications of Pascal’s Principle
body: Pascal’s principle became the basis for one of the most important machines ever developed, that is the hydraulic lift (press).
A simple hydraulic lift of the variety used to raise a car in an auto shop typically consists of two large cylinders side by side.
Valves control the flow of the fluid between the two cylinders.

When a person applies force by pressing down the piston in one cylinder (the input cylinder), this yields a uniform pressure that causes output in the second cylinder, pushing up a piston that raises the car.

options.A: The weight of the submerged object

**Step 2: Select option**
Hence, the correct answer is **The weight of the fluid displaced by the object**.

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Why do our ears pop when we climb high mountains?

options.A: The temperature decreases rapidly, compressing the eardrum
options.B: The external atmospheric pressure decreases below the internal ear pressure
options.C: The internal fluid density of the ear decreases
options.D: The gravitational force pulling on the ear increases

cards.why:
**Step 1: Analyze physical processes at altitude**
As altitude increases, atmospheric density and pressure drop exponentially.

**Step 2: Relate to inner ear pressure**
The air trapped inside the middle ear remains initially at the higher sea-level pressure. The imbalance (internal pressure > external atmospheric pressure) forces the eardrum outward until air escapes through the Eustachian tube, creating a "popping" sensation to restore equilibrium. Thus, the correct option is **The external atmospheric pressure decreases below the internal ear pressure**.

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: A fully submerged stone sinks deeper into a deep pool of fresh water. What happens to the buoyant force acting on it?

options.D: It drops to zero at extreme depths

cards.why:
**Step 1: Analyze the variables in buoyant force formula**
$$F_B = \rho_f V_o g$$

**Step 2: Evaluate constants**
Water density ($$\rho_f$$) is essentially constant because liquids are highly incompressible. The volume of the submerged stone ($$V_o$$) and gravity ($$g$$) are constant. Therefore, the buoyant force **remains virtually constant** regardless of depth.

A concept related to density is the relative density (or specific gravity) of a material, which is the ratio of the material’s density to the density of water.
Relative density is a dimensionless quantity.
The density of any substance in grams per cubic centimetre is identical with the relative density; its density in kilograms per cubic metre is 1000 times its relative density.

By increasing the intensity of the light of given wavelength, there is only an increase in the number of photons per second crossing a given area, with each photon having the same energy.
